# Thinking Machines

Use `thinkingmachines/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "thinkingmachines-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "thinkingmachines/Qwen/Qwen3-8B",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `TINKER_API_KEY`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/anthropic`

## Default base URL

`https://tinker.thinkingmachines.dev/services/tinker-prod/anthropic/api/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `THINKINGMACHINES_BASE_URL`.

## Provider docs

- https://tinker-docs.thinkingmachines.ai/tinker/compatible-apis/anthropic/
